terms.title: Service Terms · SoyaOS Developer Portal
terms.heading: Service terms
terms.effective: Effective August 20, 2026. SoyaOS Cloud v0.2.0 is a free, single-region, best-effort text-agent service with no SLA.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Use the service only for lawful text-agent workloads. Do not probe other tenants, evade quotas, distribute credentials, overload the service, or submit malware, exploit instructions, illegal content or third-party confidential data without permission.

sections.title: v0.2.0 limits
sections.body: The stable v0.2.0 surface is limited to the documented models, APIs and quotas. The service does not include arbitrary code execution, tool calls, billing, organization tenants, data residency, multi-region recovery or production support.

sections.title: Your content
sections.body: You remain responsible for prompts and outputs and must have the rights needed to submit them. Content is sent to the managed inference upstream as described in the Privacy Notice. Verify model output before relying on it.

sections.title: Availability and access
sections.body: The service is provided as-is and without uptime, support or fitness guarantees. SoyaOS may suspend keys or access to protect users, control cost, investigate abuse or operate the service safely.

terms.note: These terms describe the released v0.2.0 product boundary. Stable does not imply an uptime SLA.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice · SoyaOS Developer Portal
privacy.heading: Privacy notice
privacy.effective: Effective August 20, 2026. This notice describes the limited data used by the free SoyaOS Cloud v0.2.0 service.
keeps: Your GitHub numeric user ID, login, display name and encrypted Portal session.
API Key identifiers, prefixes and one-way HMAC digests. Raw keys are shown once.
For 24 hours: request ID, tenant and Key IDs, model, timestamps, latency, status, token counts and normalized error code.
privacy.inference: Prompts and generated responses are sent to Cloudflare Workers AI to perform inference. SoyaOS does not persist those bodies in D1 or request traces. Do not submit secrets, regulated data or content that requires a guaranteed residency region.
privacy.location: The control-data primary currently runs in Cloudflare's Western North America region (WNAM). Requests may be processed on Cloudflare's managed network; the service makes no data-residency commitment. Trace metadata expires after 24 hours. You can revoke keys at any time; account deletion requests can be filed in the public developer-portal repository.
privacy.note: This service is not intended for sensitive or production-regulated workloads.
